records.footnote: Data on carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from fuel combustion (Gg CO2) are estimated using 2006 Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories and Global Warming Potential values from the IPCC 5th Assessment Report.  In accordance with 2006 IPCC Guidelines, figures may be periodically updated as more accurate data are made available.  Data are used for SDG 9.4.1 'CO2 emission per unit of value added'.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 9.4.1.
